notes.title: Cool off with the Steam Summer Sale – get up to 90% off PQube Games!
notes.notes:
Ah, summer. Sundresses, ice cream…and, of course, some crazy discounts on games! With everything from pixel platformers to furr-tastic RPGs, there is something for everyone in the PQube catalogue. Check out some of our top picks below!

Gal*Gun Returns

PANTIES! Got your attention? It’s ok, your secret’s safe with us. Escape hordes of amorous schoolgirls in infamous ecchi rail-shooter Gal*Gun Returns – now 20% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1425730/

Inertial Drift

Let off some steam (!) with this innovative twin-stick racing game, now at 33% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1184480/

Cat Quest II

Cats or dogs? Single player or co-op? No need to pick- we’ve got both in this wildly popular action-RPG! Now at 45% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/914710/

Songbird Symphony

Guide orphaned chick ‘Birb’ through a beautifully crafted pixel world in this rhythm-action platformer: now 55% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/909820/

Die After Sunset

OK, this one isn’t in the sale, but we think you’ll love it all the same. Battle for Earth and travel through time this newly announced 3rd person action roguelite. But be careful! You never know what’s lurking in the shadows…

Wishlist now to be the first to get updates on Die After Sunset, coming soon to Steam Early Access.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1440010/

notes.title: Quantum Replica Jumps To Consoles!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25858444/100f9fbb7b832fa79f606eeef37830947cc23be7.png[/img]

[h3]Explore a cyberpunk-inspired world. Discover your forgotten past. [/h3]

[b]It's time to enjoy this top-down stealth action adventure once again as Quantum Replica makes the jump to consoles[/b][b]![/b] We're delighted to announce the release will be on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One and next generation consoles via backwards compatibility!

Wrapped in a [b]gorgeous cyberpunk aesthetic[/b], Quantum Replica lets you take the role of ‘Alpha’, as you attempt to infiltrate a shadowy government organisation: [b]the 'Syndicate',[/b] In an attempt to reclaim your lost memories, control time and sneak your way through five unique districts, as you[b] battle through state police, tight security, and heavily armed bosses![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25858444/29c2c7a8eda3fd605bb5f04c142edd9d7e22e52d.gif[/img]

[h3]Quantum Replica is out now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Steam, as well as PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X via backwards compatibility![/h3]

notes.title: Quantum Replica - New Update Out NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25858444/34722e4d7225f309ad153b07bb8a96e4bd9b1244.jpg[/img]

Hey guys,

we are still working on the game to get rid of the nasty bugs you are so kindly reporting (thank you for that!) and improve it in as many aspects as possible.

Here is the full changelog:


Fix on Draggable Actors.
Several player feddback adds, like:
	-Hit animations
	-Sounds while damaged is received
	-Map markers
	-Alert time feedback to let player know the remaining time until enemies return to their patrol
	-Full Stealth Mode Icons on instakill rooms
	-Soldiers, drones and light color changes in instakill room
	-Some in-game sequences are now fully skippables
Improved and more responsive AI.
Hack games abort automatically when player receives damage.
Map starts on full zoom.
When the player grabs dash level 2 a camera sequence shows the exit.
Checkpoint before some objectives.


Known Issues:

Before the trash compactor, if the player died and is spawned at the checkpoint to immeadiatelly walk to the trash compactor sequence, the screen keep the black fade
.
Same black fade issue happened on TKST when spawned before the fight starts.
Airport Boxes where the player didn't return to the initial position of the puzzle.
Issue where the cars and buses didn't had collissions after the tank persecution.
VR devices were recognized if plugged in
.
Some Places where the player wasnt suppose to reach were reachable with dash.

notes.title: Quantum Replica - Official Launch Trailer [4K]
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

May 31th is almost here and we prepared a Launch Trailer for you!

[url]https://youtu.be/4DcyBN0H_zI[/url]

The combination of neon lit shadows with a cyberpunk metropolis creates a distinct futuristic atmosphere in Quantum Replica. Being a “most wanted” person, with no recollection of the past, Alpha, our main character works towards forming a full picture what was and what may lie ahead, with only brief glimpses of events to piece together and make sense of.  Many adversaries stand in his way, but his special abilities of time manipulation, as well as numerous weapons and gadgets at his disposal, will be of help on his pre-determined path in search of the truth.

Are you ready?
